title.zh: 卷十九 本紀第十九: 成宗二
title.raw: 卷十九 本紀第十九: 成宗二 Volume 19 Annals 19: Chengzong 2

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙子，詔蠲兩都站戶和顧和市。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, on bingzi day, an edict remitted corvée purchase and market purchase for relay households of the two capitals.
translations.idiomatic: Second year, spring, first month, on bingzi day, an edict remitted corvée purchase and market purchase for relay households of the two capitals.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔江南毋捕天鵝。

translations.literal: On jimao day, an edict ordered that Jiangnan must not capture swans.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, an edict ordered that Jiangnan must not capture swans.

sentences.zh: 以忽剌出千戶所部屯夫貧乏，免其所輸租。

translations.literal: Because garrison-farming laborers under Hulachu's ten-thousand-household office were impoverished, the rent they owed was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Because garrison-farming laborers under Hulachu's ten-thousand-household office were impoverished, the rent they owed was remitted.

sentences.zh: 上思州叛賊黃勝許攻剽水口思光寨，湖廣行省調兵擊破之，獲其黨黃法安等，賊遁入上牙六羅。

translations.literal: Huang Shengxu, rebel bandit of Shangsi Prefecture, attacked and plundered the Siguang stockade at Shuikou; the Huguang branch secretariat mobilized troops, broke them, and captured his followers Huang Fa'an and others; the bandits fled into Shangya Liuluo.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shengxu, rebel bandit of Shangsi Prefecture, attacked and plundered the Siguang stockade at Shuikou; the Huguang branch secretariat mobilized troops, broke them, and captured his followers Huang Fa'an and others; the bandits fled into Shangya Liuluo.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太陰犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On renwu day the moon encroached upon Yuhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the moon encroached upon Yuhui.

sentences.zh: 詔凡戶隸貴赤者，諸人毋爭。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for all households subordinate to keshik, no one was to contend over them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that for all households subordinate to keshik, no one was to contend over them.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命西平王奧魯赤今夏居上都。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Prince of Xiping Aoluchi was ordered to reside at Shangdu this summer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince of Xiping Aoluchi was ordered to reside at Shangdu this summer.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 安西王傅鐵赤、脫鐵木而等復請立王相府，帝曰：「去歲阿難答已嘗面陳，朕以世祖定制諭之，今復奏請，豈欲以四川、京兆悉為彼有耶？

translations.literal: Prince Anxi's tutor Tiechi, Tuotuomu'er, and others again requested establishment of a princely chancellor's office; the Emperor said: "Last year Ananda already stated this in person; We instructed him with Shizu's established regulations; now you again memorialize — do you wish to make all of Sichuan and Jingzhao entirely yours?
translations.idiomatic: Prince Anxi's tutor Tiechi, Tuotuomu'er, and others again requested establishment of a princely chancellor's office; the Emperor said, "Last year Ananda already stated this in person; We instructed him with Shizu's established regulations; now you again memorialize — do you wish to make all of Sichuan and Jingzhao entirely yours?

sentences.zh: 賦稅、軍站，皆朝廷所司，今姑從汝請，置王相府，惟行王傅事。

translations.literal: Tax levies and military relay stations are all under court administration; for now We shall accede to your request and establish a princely chancellor's office, but it may handle only princely-tutor affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Tax levies and military relay stations are all under court administration; for now We shall accede to your request and establish a princely chancellor's office, but it may handle only princely-tutor affairs."

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，太陰犯平道。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.

sentences.zh: 己丑，御史臺臣言：「漢人為同寮者，嘗為奸人捃摭其罪，由是不敢盡言。

translations.literal: On jichou day censorate officials said: "Han Chinese who serve as colleagues have often had their crimes gathered up by wicked men, and therefore dare not speak fully.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day censorate officials said, "Han Chinese who serve as colleagues have often had their crimes gathered up by wicked men, and therefore dare not speak fully.

sentences.zh: 請於近侍昔寶赤、速古而赤中，擇人用之。

translations.literal: We request selecting men from among close attendants Sibaozhi and Sugurji."
translations.idiomatic: We request selecting men from among close attendants Sibaozhi and Sugurji."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「安用此曹？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "What use are such men?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "What use are such men?

sentences.zh: 其選漢人識達事體者為之。

translations.literal: Select Han Chinese who understand affairs and are competent to serve."
translations.idiomatic: Select Han Chinese who understand affairs and are competent to serve."

sentences.zh: 」以御史中丞禿赤為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Tuochi was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Tuochi was made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太陰犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the moon encroached upon Gouqin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the moon encroached upon Gouqin.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，令月赤察而也可及合剌赤所部衛士自運軍糧，給其行費。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Ochicharu, Bolad, and guards under Helazhi's command were ordered to transport army grain themselves; their travel expenses were supplied.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Ochicharu, Bolad, and guards under Helazhi's command were ordered to transport army grain themselves; their travel expenses were supplied.

sentences.zh: 甲午，授嗣漢三十八代天師張與材太素凝神廣道真人，管領江南諸路道教。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Zhang Yucai, thirty-eighth-generation successor Han Celestial Master, was granted the title Perfect Man of Supreme Purity, Numinous Concentration, and Expansive Way and put in charge of Daoism on all Jiangnan circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Zhang Yucai, thirty-eighth-generation successor Han Celestial Master, was granted the title Perfect Man of Supreme Purity, Numinous Concentration, and Expansive Way and put in charge of Daoism on all Jiangnan circuits.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔諸王、公主、駙馬非奉旨毋罪官吏，賜諸王合班妃鈔千二百錠、雜幣帛千匹，駙馬塔海鐵木而鈔三千錠。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, an edict ordered that princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law must not punish officials without receiving an imperial order; Prince Heban's consort was granted one thousand two hundred ingots of notes and one thousand bolts of miscellaneous silks and cloths; imperial son-in-law Tahai Temür was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, an edict ordered that princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law must not punish officials without receiving an imperial order; Prince Heban's consort was granted 1,200 ingots of notes and 1,000 bolts of miscellaneous silks and cloths; imperial son-in-law Tahai Temür was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 回紇不剌罕獻獅、豹、藥物，賜鈔千三百餘錠。

translations.literal: Uighur Bolad Khan presented lions, leopards, and medicinal substances; he was granted more than one thousand three hundred ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Uighur Bolad Khan presented lions, leopards, and medicinal substances; he was granted more than 1,300 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥朔，中書省臣言：「陛下自御極以來，所賜諸王、公主、駙馬、勛臣，為數不輕，向之所儲，散之殆盡。

translations.literal: Second month, yihai new moon: central secretariat officials said: "Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, what has been granted to princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious ministers has been no small amount; what was formerly stored has nearly all been dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yihai new moon: central secretariat officials said, "Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, what has been granted to princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious ministers has been no small amount; what was formerly stored has nearly all been dispersed.

sentences.zh: 今繼請者尚多，臣等乞甄別貧匱及赴邊者賜之，其餘宜悉止。

translations.literal: Those who continue to request are still many; we beg to grant only to the destitute and those going to the frontier; the rest should all be stopped."
translations.idiomatic: Those who continue to request are still many; we beg to grant only to the destitute and those going to the frontier; the rest should all be stopped."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 分江浙行省軍萬人戍湖廣。

translations.literal: Ten thousand troops from the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat were divided to garrison Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: 10,000 troops from the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat were divided to garrison Huguang.

sentences.zh: 給稱海屯田軍農具。

translations.literal: Chenghai garrison-farming troops were supplied with agricultural implements.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghai garrison-farming troops were supplied with agricultural implements.

sentences.zh: 詔奉使及軍官歿而子弟未襲職者，其所佩金銀符歸於官，違者罪之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that where envoys or military officers died and their sons had not yet inherited office, the gold and silver tallies they wore were to be returned to the government; violators were punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that where envoys or military officers died and their sons had not yet inherited office, the gold and silver tallies they wore were to be returned to the government; violators were punished.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，立中禦府，以脫忽伯、唐兀並為中禦卿。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the Central Imperial Guard Office was established; Tughbuqa and Tangwu were both made directors of the central guard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Central Imperial Guard Office was established; Tughbuqa and Tangwu were both made directors of the central guard.

sentences.zh: 丙午，禁軍將擅易侍衛軍、蒙古軍，以家奴代役者罪之，仍令其奴別入兵籍，以其主資產之半畀之，軍將敢有縱之者，罷其職。

translations.literal: On bingwu day military commanders were forbidden privately to swap guard troops and Mongol troops; those who used household slaves to substitute for service were punished, and the slaves were separately entered into military registers and half their master's assets given them; commanders who dared condone it were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day military commanders were forbidden privately to swap guard troops and Mongol troops; those who used household slaves to substitute for service were punished, and the slaves were separately entered into military registers and half their master's assets given them; commanders who dared condone it were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 括蒙古戶漸丁，以充行伍。

translations.literal: Reaching adult age among Mongol households was registered to fill the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching adult age among Mongol households was registered to fill the ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁未，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon Jing.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔軍卒擅更代及逃歸者死。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, an edict ordered that soldiers who privately exchanged assignments or fled and returned were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, an edict ordered that soldiers who privately exchanged assignments or fled and returned were put to death.

sentences.zh: 給禿禿合所部屯田農器。

translations.literal: Tutuhe's division was supplied with garrison-farm agricultural implements.
translations.idiomatic: Tutuhe's division was supplied with garrison-farm agricultural implements.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔江南道士貿易、田者，輸田、商稅。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict ordered that Jiangnan Daoist priests who traded or held land must pay land and commercial taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, an edict ordered that Jiangnan Daoist priests who traded or held land must pay land and commercial taxes.

sentences.zh: 庚申，命劄剌而忽都虎所部戶居於奉聖、雲州者，與民均供徭役。

translations.literal: On gengshen day households under Jarligh Qutuqhu's command residing at Fengsheng and Yunzhou were to share corvée equally with commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day households under Jarligh Qutuqhu's command residing at Fengsheng and Yunzhou were to share corvée equally with commoners.

sentences.zh: 自六盤山至黃河立屯田，置軍萬人。

translations.literal: From Liupan Mountain to the Yellow River garrison-farm fields were established; ten thousand troops were stationed.
translations.idiomatic: From Liupan Mountain to the Yellow River garrison-farm fields were established; 10,000 troops were stationed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以大都留守司達魯花赤段貞為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Duan Zhen, Dadu intendant, was made vice grand councillor of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Duan Zhen, Dadu intendant, was made vice grand councillor of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遣使代祀嶽瀆。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial substitutes at the peaks and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to perform sacrificial substitutes at the peaks and rivers.

sentences.zh: 賜安西王米三千石，以賑饑民。

translations.literal: Three thousand shi of rice was granted to Prince Anxi to relieve famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: 3,000 shi of rice was granted to Prince Anxi to relieve famine victims.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，以中書平章政事不忽木為昭文館大學士，平章軍國事。

translations.literal: Third month, on renshen day Buhua, vice grand councillor of the central secretariat, was made Hanlin academician-expositor of the Zhaowen Hall and vice councillor for military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on renshen day Buhua, vice grand councillor of the central secretariat, was made Hanlin academician-expositor of the Zhaowen Hall and vice councillor for military and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 罷太原、平陽路釀進蒲萄酒，其蒲萄園民恃為業者，皆還之。

translations.literal: Brewing and presenting grape wine at Taiyuan and Pingyang routes was abolished; commoners who relied on grape gardens as their livelihood were all restored to them.
translations.idiomatic: Brewing and presenting grape wine at Taiyuan and Pingyang routes was abolished; commoners who relied on grape gardens as their livelihood were all restored to them.

sentences.zh: 諸王出伯言所部探馬赤軍懦弱者三千餘人，乞代以強壯，從之，仍命出伯非奉旨毋擅征發。

translations.literal: More than three thousand weak tammaq troops under Prince Chuban's command requested replacement with strong men; approved; also ordered that Chuban must not privately mobilize troops without an imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: More than 3,000 weak tammaq troops under Prince Chuban's command requested replacement with strong men; approved; also ordered that Chuban must not privately mobilize troops without an imperial order.

sentences.zh: 以怯魯剌駐夏民饑，戶給糧六月。

translations.literal: Because people at Qerlur summer residence suffered famine, each household was given six months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: Because people at Qerlur summer residence suffered famine, each household was given six months' grain.

sentences.zh: 郡王慶童有疾，以其子也裏不花代之。

translations.literal: Prince Qingtong was ill; his son Yelibuhua was made to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Qingtong was ill; his son Yelibuhua was made to replace him.

sentences.zh: 賜八撒、火而忽答孫、禿剌三人鈔各千錠。

translations.literal: Princes Basar, Huo'erhudasun, and Tula were each granted one thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Basar, Huo'erhudasun, and Tula were each granted 1,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 治書侍御史萬僧受賕，命御史臺與宣政院使答失蠻雜治之。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Wanseng accepted bribes; the censorate and Xuanzheng Bureau commissioner Dashman were jointly ordered to try the case.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Wanseng accepted bribes; the censorate and Xuanzheng Bureau commissioner Dashman were jointly ordered to try the case.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，增駐夏軍為四萬人。

translations.literal: On guiyou day summer-stationed troops were increased to forty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day summer-stationed troops were increased to 40,000 men.

sentences.zh: 忻都言晉王甘麻剌，朵兒帶言月兒魯，皆有異圖，詔樞密院鞫之，無驗。

translations.literal: Xindu said Prince of Jin Gammala and Do'erdai said Yue'erlu each harbored secret designs; an edict ordered the privy council to interrogate them; nothing was verified.
translations.idiomatic: Xindu said Prince of Jin Gammala and Do'erdai said Yue'erlu each harbored secret designs; an edict ordered the privy council to interrogate them; nothing was verified.

sentences.zh: 帝命言晉王者死，言月兒魯者謫從軍自效。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered death for the one who accused the Prince of Jin, and the one who accused Yue'erlu was banished to military service to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered death for the one who accused the Prince of Jin, and the one who accused Yue'erlu was banished to military service to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 詔雲南行臺檢劾亦乞不薛宣慰司案牘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Yunnan regional censorate to examine and impeach the case documents of the Yiqibusi pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Yunnan regional censorate to examine and impeach the case documents of the Yiqibusi pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣諸王亦只裏、八不沙、亦憐真、也裏慳、甕吉剌帶並駐夏於晉王怯魯剌之地。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Princes Yisizhili, Babusha, Yilinzhen, Yeliqian, and Wengjiladai were all dispatched to summer-station at Prince of Jin Qerlur's territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Princes Yisizhili, Babusha, Yilinzhen, Yeliqian, and Wengjiladai were all dispatched to summer-station at Prince of Jin Qerlur's territory.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以完顏邦義、納速丁、劉季安妄議朝政，杖之，徒二年，籍其家財之半。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Wanyan Bangyi, Nasuding, and Liu Ji'an were sentenced for presumptuously discussing court affairs: beaten, sentenced to two years' exile, and half their household property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Wanyan Bangyi, Nasuding, and Liu Ji'an were sentenced for presumptuously discussing court affairs: beaten, sentenced to two years' exile, and half their household property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 甲申，次大口。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the Emperor halted at Dakou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor halted at Dakou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太陰犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the moon encroached upon Gouqin.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the moon encroached upon Gouqin.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜遼陽行省糧三萬石。

translations.literal: On xinmao day thirty thousand shi of grain was granted to the Liaoyang branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day 30,000 shi of grain was granted to the Liaoyang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔駙馬亦都護括流散畏吾而戶。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Yidu Hu to register dispersed Uighur households.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, an edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Yidu Hu to register dispersed Uighur households.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，湖廣行省以叛賊黃勝許黨魯萬醜、王獻於京師。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Huguang branch secretariat sent to the capital Lu Wanchou and Wang Xian, followers of the rebel bandit Huang Shengxu.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Huguang branch secretariat sent to the capital Lu Wanchou and Wang Xian, followers of the rebel bandit Huang Shengxu.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王鐵木兒金二百五十兩、銀二千五百兩、鈔五千錠，以旌其戰功。

translations.literal: Prince Temür was granted two hundred fifty taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and five thousand ingots of notes to honor his battle merit.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Temür was granted 250 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 5,000 ingots of notes to honor his battle merit.

sentences.zh: 以合伯及塔塔剌所部民饑，賑米各千石。

translations.literal: Because the people under Hebo and Tatara suffered famine, one thousand shi of relief rice was granted to each.
translations.idiomatic: Because the people under Hebo and Tatara suffered famine, 1,000 shi of relief rice was granted to each.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥朔，命撒的迷失招集其祖忙兀臺所部流散人戶。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jihai new moon: Sadishmiss was ordered to gather the dispersed people under his ancestor Mangudai's command.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, jihai new moon: Sadishmiss was ordered to gather the dispersed people under his ancestor Mangudai's command.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王八卜沙鈔四萬錠，也真所部六萬錠。

translations.literal: Prince Babusha was granted forty thousand ingots of notes; Yezhen's division sixty thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Babusha was granted 40,000 ingots of notes; Yezhen's division 60,000 ingots.

sentences.zh: 平陽之絳州、臺州路之黃巖州饑，杭州火，並賑之。

translations.literal: Jiangzhou of Pingyang, Huangyan Prefecture of Taizhou Route suffered famine; Hangzhou suffered fire; all were given relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhou of Pingyang, Huangyan Prefecture of Taizhou Route suffered famine; Hangzhou suffered fire; all were given relief.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰朔，免兩都徭役。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wuchen new moon: corvée of the two capitals was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuchen new moon: corvée of the two capitals was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，安西王遣使來告貧乏，帝語之曰：「世祖以分賚之難，嘗有聖訓，阿難答亦知之矣。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Prince Anxi sent envoys reporting destitution; the Emperor told them: "Shizu, because of the difficulty of divided grants, once gave a sacred instruction, which Ananda also knows.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Prince Anxi sent envoys reporting destitution; the Emperor told them, "Shizu, because of the difficulty of divided grants, once gave a sacred instruction, which Ananda also knows.

sentences.zh: 若言貧乏，豈獨汝耶？

translations.literal: If you speak of destitution, are you alone in that?
translations.idiomatic: If you speak of destitution, are you alone in that?

sentences.zh: 去歲賜鈔二十萬錠，又給以糧，今與，則諸王以為不均；

translations.literal: Last year twenty thousand ingots of notes were granted, and grain was also supplied; if We grant now, the princes will think it uneven;
translations.idiomatic: Last year 20,000 ingots of notes were granted, and grain was also supplied; if We grant now, the princes will think it uneven;

sentences.zh: 不與，則汝言人多饑死。

translations.literal: If We do not grant, you say many people are starving to death.
translations.idiomatic: If We do not grant, you say many people are starving to death.

sentences.zh: 其給糧萬石，擇貧者賑之。

translations.literal: Grant ten thousand shi of grain and distribute it to relieve the destitute."
translations.idiomatic: Grant 10,000 shi of grain and distribute it to relieve the destitute."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，詔民間馬牛羊，百取其一，羊不滿百者亦取之，惟色目人及數乃取。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, an edict ordered: among private horses, cattle, and sheep of the people, one in a hundred was taken; where sheep numbered fewer than a hundred they were still taken; only semuren and nursing lambs were exempt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, an edict ordered: among private horses, cattle, and sheep of the people, one in a hundred was taken; where sheep numbered fewer than a hundred they were still taken; only semuren and nursing lambs were exempt.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太陰犯平道。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Pingdao.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，土蕃叛，殺掠階州軍民，遣脫脫會諸王鐵木而不花、只列等合兵討之。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Tubo rebelled, killing and plundering troops and civilians of Jie Prefecture; Toghto was dispatched to join Prince Temür Budaq, Jilie, and others in combined forces to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Tubo rebelled, killing and plundering troops and civilians of Jie Prefecture; Toghto was dispatched to join Prince Temür Budaq, Jilie, and others in combined forces to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命也真、薛阇罕駐夏於合亦而之地。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Yezhen and Seshan were ordered to summer-station at Heyier territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Yezhen and Seshan were ordered to summer-station at Heyier territory.

sentences.zh: 禁諸王、公主、駙馬招戶。

translations.literal: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to recruit households.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were forbidden to recruit households.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔諸徒役者，限一年釋之，毋杖。

translations.literal: On jichou day, an edict ordered that all those sentenced to penal corvée be released within one year and not flogged.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, an edict ordered that all those sentenced to penal corvée be released within one year and not flogged.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷四川馬湖進獨本蔥。

translations.literal: On gengyin day tribute of single-stalk scallions from Mahu in Sichuan was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day tribute of single-stalk scallions from Mahu in Sichuan was abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔諸王、駙馬及有分地功臣戶。

translations.literal: An edict ordered households of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious ministers with allotted domains.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered households of princes, imperial sons-in-law, and meritorious ministers with allotted domains.

sentences.zh: 居上都、大都、隆興者，與民均納供需。

translations.literal: Those residing at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were to share provision and corvée equally with commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Those residing at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were to share provision and corvée equally with commoners.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命諸行省非奉旨毋擅調軍。

translations.literal: On dingyou day branch secretariats were ordered not to mobilize troops without receiving an imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day branch secretariats were ordered not to mobilize troops without receiving an imperial order.

sentences.zh: 安南國遣人招誘叛賊黃勝許。

translations.literal: The kingdom of Annam sent men to entice the rebel bandit Huang Shengxu.
translations.idiomatic: The kingdom of Annam sent men to entice the rebel bandit Huang Shengxu.

sentences.zh: 也黑迷失進紫檀，賜鈔四千錠。

translations.literal: Yeheimi presented red sandalwood; he was granted four thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Yeheimi presented red sandalwood; he was granted 4,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 是月，野蠶成繭。

translations.literal: That month, wild silkworms formed cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: That month, wild silkworms formed cocoons.

sentences.zh: 河中府之猗氏雹；

translations.literal: Yishi County in Hezhong Prefecture suffered hail;
translations.idiomatic: Yishi County in Hezhong Prefecture suffered hail;

sentences.zh: 太原之平晉，獻州之交河、樂壽，莫州之莫亭、任丘，及湖南醴陵州皆水；

translations.literal: Pingjin in Taiyuan, Jiaohe and Leshou in Xian Prefecture, Mo Pavilion and Renqiu in Mo Prefecture, and Liling Prefecture in Hunan all suffered flooding;
translations.idiomatic: Pingjin in Taiyuan, Jiaohe and Leshou in Xian Prefecture, Mo Pavilion and Renqiu in Mo Prefecture, and Liling Prefecture in Hunan all suffered flooding;

sentences.zh: 濟寧之濟州螟。

translations.literal: Jizhou in Jining suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou in Jining suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，給出伯軍馬七千二百餘匹。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jihai day seven thousand two hundred-odd horses were granted to Prince Chuban's troops.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on jihai day 7,200-odd horses were granted to Prince Chuban's troops.

sentences.zh: 詔晉王所部衣糧，糧以歲給，衣則三年賜之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that clothing and grain for the Prince of Jin's following: grain was granted annually, clothing every three years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that clothing and grain for the Prince of Jin's following: grain was granted annually, clothing every three years.

sentences.zh: 給瓜州、沙州站戶牛種田具。

translations.literal: Relay households at Guazhou and Shazhou were supplied with oxen and farm implements.
translations.idiomatic: Relay households at Guazhou and Shazhou were supplied with oxen and farm implements.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「官吏受賂，初既辭伏，繼以審核，而有司徇情致令異辭者，乞加等論罪。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "Where officials accepted bribes, at first they confessed, but upon subsequent review officials who showed favor caused them to change their testimony; we request increased punishment by one grade."
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Where officials accepted bribes, at first they confessed, but upon subsequent review officials who showed favor caused them to change their testimony; we request increased punishment by one grade."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太白犯天關。

translations.literal: On yisi day Venus encroached upon Tianguan.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Venus encroached upon Tianguan.

sentences.zh: 以調兵妨農，免廣西容州等處田租一年。

translations.literal: Because mobilizing troops had harmed farming, field rent in Rong Prefecture and other places in Guangxi was remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Because mobilizing troops had harmed farming, field rent in Rong Prefecture and other places in Guangxi was remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 丙午，叛賊黃勝許遁入交趾。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the rebel bandit Huang Shengxu fled into Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the rebel bandit Huang Shengxu fled into Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，降官吏受賕條格，凡十有三等。

translations.literal: On jiayin day regulations on bribery by officials were promulgated, thirteen grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day regulations on bribery by officials were promulgated, 13 grades in all.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太白犯填星。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Venus encroached upon Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Venus encroached upon Saturn.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太陰犯井。

translations.literal: On guihai day the moon encroached upon Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon encroached upon Jing.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔行省、行臺，凡朱清有所陳列，毋輒止之。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, an edict ordered branch secretariats and regional censorates not to stop whatever Zhu Qing submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, an edict ordered branch secretariats and regional censorates not to stop whatever Zhu Qing submitted.

sentences.zh: 賜西平王奧魯赤銀二百五十兩、鈔六千錠，所部六萬錠，諸王亦憐真所部二十萬錠，兀魯思駐冬軍三萬錠。

translations.literal: Prince of Xiping Aoluchi was granted two hundred fifty taels of silver and six thousand ingots of notes; his following sixty thousand ingots; Prince Yilinzhen's following two hundred thousand ingots; Ulus winter-stationed troops thirty thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xiping Aoluchi was granted 250 taels of silver and 6,000 ingots of notes; his following 60,000 ingots; Prince Yilinzhen's following 200,000 ingots; Ulus winter-stationed troops 30,000 ingots.

sentences.zh: 是月，大都、真定、保定、太平、常州、鎮江、紹興、建康、澧州、岳州、廬州、汝寧、龍陽州、漢陽、濟寧、東平、大名、滑州、德州蝗，大同、隆興、順德、太原雹。

translations.literal: That month, locusts in Dadu, Baoding, Bianliang, Jiangling, Mianyang, Huai'an, Taiping, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing, Jiankang, Lizhou, Yuezhou, Luzhou, Runing, Longyang Prefecture, Hanyang, Jining, Dongping, Daming, Huazhou, and Dezhou; hail in Datong, Longxing, Shunde, and Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, locusts in Dadu, Baoding, Bianliang, Jiangling, Mianyang, Huai'an, Taiping, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Shaoxing, Jiankang, Lizhou, Yuezhou, Luzhou, Runing, Longyang Prefecture, Hanyang, Jining, Dongping, Daming, Huazhou, and Dezhou; hail in Datong, Longxing, Shunde, and Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 海南民饑，發粟賑之。

translations.literal: The people of Hainan suffered famine; grain was issued to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Hainan suffered famine; grain was issued to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，肇州萬戶府立屯田，給以農具、種、食。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day Zhao Prefecture ten-thousand-household office established garrison-farm fields; agricultural tools, seed, and food were supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day Zhao Prefecture ten-thousand-household office established garrison-farm fields; agricultural tools, seed, and food were supplied.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以鈔十一萬八千錠給西蕃諸驛。

translations.literal: On xinwei day notes of one hundred eighteen thousand ingots were granted to various Tibetan relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day notes of 118,000 ingots were granted to various Tibetan relay stations.

sentences.zh: 甘、肅兩州驛戶饑，給糧有差。

translations.literal: Relay households in Gan and Su prefectures suffered famine; grain was granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Relay households in Gan and Su prefectures suffered famine; grain was granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王完澤印。

translations.literal: Prince Wanze was granted a seal.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Wanze was granted a seal.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔茶鹽轉運司、印鈔提舉司、運糧漕運司官，仍舊以三年為代；

translations.literal: On guiyou day an edict ordered officials of the tea and salt transport commission, note-treasury commission, and grain-transport waterway commission to continue serving three-year terms as before;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict ordered officials of the tea and salt transport commission, note-treasury commission, and grain-transport waterway commission to continue serving three-year terms as before;

sentences.zh: 雲南、福建官吏滿任者，給驛以歸。

translations.literal: Officials in Yunnan and Fujian who completed their terms were given relay transport to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in Yunnan and Fujian who completed their terms were given relay transport to return home.

sentences.zh: 壬午，填星犯井，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On renwu day Saturn encroached upon Jing, and Venus encroached upon Yuhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Saturn encroached upon Jing, and Venus encroached upon Yuhui.

sentences.zh: 括伯顏、阿術、阿裏海牙等所據江南田及權豪匿隱者，令輸租。

translations.literal: Land held by Bayan, Ashu, Alihaiya, and others in Jiangnan and concealed by powerful families was registered and ordered to pay field rent.
translations.idiomatic: Land held by Bayan, Ashu, Alihaiya, and others in Jiangnan and concealed by powerful families was registered and ordered to pay field rent.

sentences.zh: 河泊官歲入五百錠者敕授。

translations.literal: River-and-lake tax officials with annual income of five hundred ingots were appointed by imperial decree.
translations.idiomatic: River-and-lake tax officials with annual income of 500 ingots were appointed by imperial decree.

sentences.zh: 增江西、河南省參政一員，以朱清、張瑄為之。

translations.literal: One associate administrator each was added to Jiangxi and Henan provinces; Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: One associate administrator each was added to Jiangxi and Henan provinces; Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were appointed.

sentences.zh: 授特進上柱國高麗王世子王謜為儀同三司、領都僉議司事。

translations.literal: The heir apparent of Goryeo, Wang Yan, was appointed special advance and pillar of state, director with triple court honor, and chief of the Council of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent of Goryeo, Wang Yan, was appointed special advance and pillar of state, director with triple court honor, and chief of the Council of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣雲南省逃軍戍亦乞不薛，命湖廣、江西兩省擇駐夏軍牧地。

translations.literal: On yiyou day fugitive soldiers from Yunnan Province were sent to garrison Yiqibusi; Huguang and Jiangxi provinces were ordered to choose pasture lands for summer-stationed troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day fugitive soldiers from Yunnan Province were sent to garrison Yiqibusi; Huguang and Jiangxi provinces were ordered to choose pasture lands for summer-stationed troops.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣嶽樂也奴等使馬八兒國。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Yueleye Nu and others were dispatched as envoys to Ma'bar.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Yueleye Nu and others were dispatched as envoys to Ma'bar.

sentences.zh: 己丑，命行臺監察御史鉤校隨省理問所案牘，以虎賁三百人戍應昌。

translations.literal: On jichou day regional censorate surveillance censors were ordered to audit case documents at circuit-level inquiry offices; three hundred tiger-guard soldiers were sent to garrison Yingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day regional censorate surveillance censors were ordered to audit case documents at circuit-level inquiry offices; 300 tiger-guard soldiers were sent to garrison Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 諸提調錢正官，其部凡有逋欠者，勿遷敘。

translations.literal: Officials in charge of tax collection — wherever their departments had arrears — were not to receive promotion in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Officials in charge of tax collection — wherever their departments had arrears — were not to receive promotion in rank.

sentences.zh: 廣西賊陳飛、雷通、藍青、謝發寇昭、梧、藤、容等州，湖廣左丞八都馬辛擊平之。

translations.literal: Bandits Chen Fei, Lei Tong, Lan Qing, and Xie Fa in Guangxi raided Zhao, Wu, Teng, Rong, and other prefectures; Huguang left vice chancellor Batu Maxin attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits Chen Fei, Lei Tong, Lan Qing, and Xie Fa in Guangxi raided Zhao, Wu, Teng, Rong, and other prefectures; Huguang left vice chancellor Batu Maxin attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜貴由赤戍軍鈔三萬九千餘錠。

translations.literal: On xinsi day garrison troops of the Guvch guard were granted more than thirty-nine thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day garrison troops of the Guvch guard were granted more than 39,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 是月，平陽、大名，歸德、真定蝗，彰德、真定、曹州、濱州水，懷孟、大名、河間旱，太原、懷孟雹。

translations.literal: That month, locusts in Pingyang, Daming, Guide, and Zhending; floods in Zhangde, Zhending, Cao, and Bin prefectures; drought in Huaimeng, Daming, and Hejian; hail in Taiyuan and Huaimeng.
translations.idiomatic: That month, locusts in Pingyang, Daming, Guide, and Zhending; floods in Zhangde, Zhending, Cao, and Bin prefectures; drought in Huaimeng, Daming, and Hejian; hail in Taiyuan and Huaimeng.

sentences.zh: 福建、廣西兩江道饑，賑粟有差。

translations.literal: Fujian and Guangxi's two Jiang circuits suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian and Guangxi's two Jiang circuits suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉朔，禁舶商毋以金銀過海，諸使海外國者不得為商。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingyou new moon: merchants on seagoing vessels were forbidden to take gold and silver overseas; all envoys to foreign countries were forbidden from engaging in trade.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingyou new moon: merchants on seagoing vessels were forbidden to take gold and silver overseas; all envoys to foreign countries were forbidden from engaging in trade.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太陰犯亢，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On gengzi day the moon encroached upon Kang, and Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon encroached upon Kang, and Venus encroached upon Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，命江浙行省以船五十艘、水工千三百人，沿海巡禁私鹽。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Jiangzhe branch secretariat was ordered to use fifty vessels and one thousand three hundred water workers to patrol the coast and suppress private salt.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Jiangzhe branch secretariat was ordered to use 50 vessels and 1,300 water workers to patrol the coast and suppress private salt.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On guimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjiang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔諸人告捕盜賊者，強盜一名賞鈔五十貫，竊盜半之，應捕者又半之，皆征諸犯人，無可征者官給。

translations.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered rewards for reporting and capturing bandits: fifty strings of notes for one robber, half for a thief, half again for the capturing officer — all levied on the criminal; where none could be levied, the government paid.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered rewards for reporting and capturing bandits: 50 strings of notes for one robber, half for a thief, half again for the capturing officer — all levied on the criminal; where none could be levied, the government paid.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太陰犯天街，太白犯上將。

translations.literal: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjie, and Venus encroached upon Shangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the moon encroached upon Tianjie, and Venus encroached upon Shangjiang.

sentences.zh: 給諸王亦憐真軍糧三月。

translations.literal: Prince Yilinzhen's troops were granted three months' rations.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yilinzhen's troops were granted three months' rations.

sentences.zh: 是月，德州、彰德、太原蝗，咸寧縣，金、復州，隆興路隕霜殺禾，寧海州大雨，大名路水。

translations.literal: That month, locusts in Dezhou, Zhangde, and Taiyuan; frost killed crops in Xianning County, Jin and Fu prefectures, and Longxing Route; great rain in Ninghai Prefecture; flood in Daming Route.
translations.idiomatic: That month, locusts in Dezhou, Zhangde, and Taiyuan; frost killed crops in Xianning County, Jin and Fu prefectures, and Longxing Route; great rain in Ninghai Prefecture; flood in Daming Route.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuchen day: Venus encroached upon Zuozhifa.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wuchen day: Venus encroached upon Zuozhifa.

sentences.zh: 辛未，聖誕節，帝駐蹕安同泊，受諸王百官賀。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the Birthday Festival: the Emperor halted at Antong Po and received congratulations from princes and officials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Birthday Festival: the Emperor halted at Antong Po and received congratulations from princes and officials.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太陰掩南斗。

translations.literal: On renshen day the moon masked Nandou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the moon masked Nandou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，增鹽價鈔一引為六十五貫，鹽戶造鹽錢為十貫，獨廣西如故。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day salt prices were raised to sixty-five strings of notes per yin; salt-house production money to ten strings — Guangxi alone unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day salt prices were raised to 65 strings of notes per yin; salt-house production money to 10 strings — Guangxi alone unchanged.

sentences.zh: 征浙東、福建、湖廣夏稅。

translations.literal: Summer tax was levied in eastern Zhejiang, Fujian, and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Summer tax was levied in eastern Zhejiang, Fujian, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 罷民間鹽鐵爐竈。

translations.literal: Private salt and iron furnaces and kilns were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Private salt and iron furnaces and kilns were abolished.

sentences.zh: 給襄陽府合剌魯軍未賜田者糧兩月。

translations.literal: Qolula troops in Xiangyang Prefecture who had not yet received land grants were given two months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: Qolula troops in Xiangyang Prefecture who had not yet received land grants were given two months' grain.

sentences.zh: 罷淮西諸巡禁打捕人員。

translations.literal: Patrol, prohibition, and hunting personnel throughout Huai West were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol, prohibition, and hunting personnel throughout Huai West were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Leibizhen.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the moon encroached upon Leibizhen.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，元江賊舍資殺掠邊境，梁王命怯薛丹等討降之。

translations.literal: On wuyin day bandit Shezi of Yuanjiang killed and plundered the frontier; the Prince of Liang ordered Qixiedan and others to campaign and receive his surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day bandit Shezi of Yuanjiang killed and plundered the frontier; the Prince of Liang ordered Qixiedan and others to campaign and receive his surrender.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雲南省臣也先不花征乞藍，拔瓦農、開陽兩寨，其黨答剌率諸蠻來降，乞藍悉平，以其地為雲遠路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Yunnan provincial official Yesan Buqa campaigned against Qilan, captured Wanon and Kaiyang fortresses; his follower Dala led various tribal peoples to surrender; Qilan was entirely pacified and the territory made Yunyuan Route Military-Civilian General Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Yunnan provincial official Yesan Buqa campaigned against Qilan, captured Wanon and Kaiyang fortresses; his follower Dala led various tribal peoples to surrender; Qilan was entirely pacified and the territory made Yunyuan Route Military-Civilian General Commission.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On jichou day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon encroached upon Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，諸王出伯言汪總帥等部軍貧乏，帝以其久戍，命留五千駐冬，余悉遣還，至明年四月赴軍。
