translations.idiomatic: An Anfeng Route registrar's office was established.

sentences.zh: 以行徽政院副使王慶端為中書右丞。

translations.literal: Wang Qingduan, vice commissioner of the mobile bureau of palace affairs, was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qingduan, vice commissioner of the mobile bureau of palace affairs, was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔改元赦天下。

translations.literal: An edict changed the reign title and granted amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed the reign title and granted amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 免上都、大都、隆興差稅三年，給也只所部六千戶糧三月。

translations.literal: Corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were remitted for three years, and grain for three months was granted to the six thousand households under Gezhiye.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were remitted for three years, and grain for three months was granted to the 6,000 households under Gezhiye.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，熒惑犯井。

translations.literal: Third month, wuchen day: Mars transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuchen day: Mars transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 己巳，完澤等奏定銓調選法。

translations.literal: On jisi day Wanze and others memorialized fixing the regulations for selection and transfer.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Wanze and others memorialized fixing the regulations for selection and transfer.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以陜西行省平章也先鐵木而為中書平章政事，中書省左丞梁暗都剌為中書省右丞。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Yeshi Temür, branch secretariat grand councillor of Shaanxi, was made central secretariat grand councillor, and Liang Andula, left vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yeshi Temür, branch secretariat grand councillor of Shaanxi, was made central secretariat grand councillor, and Liang Andula, left vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太陰掩軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the Moon eclipsed the great star of Xuan Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Moon eclipsed the great star of Xuan Yuan.

sentences.zh: 畋於柳林。

translations.literal: A hunt was held at Willow Grove.
translations.idiomatic: A hunt was held at Willow Grove.

sentences.zh: 免武當山新附軍徭賦。

translations.literal: Corvée levies on newly submitted troops at Wudang Mountain were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée levies on newly submitted troops at Wudang Mountain were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，西蕃寇階州，陜西行省平章脫列伯以兵進討，其黨悉平，留軍五百人戍之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Western Tibetans raided Jie Prefecture; Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuoliebo advanced with troops to suppress them, all their bands were pacified, and five hundred troops were left to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Western Tibetans raided Jie Prefecture; Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuoliebo advanced with troops to suppress them, all their bands were pacified, and 500 troops were left to garrison.

sentences.zh: 詔各省合並鎮守軍，福建所置者合為五十三所，江浙所置者合為二百二十七所。

translations.literal: An edict ordered each province to consolidate garrison troops: those stationed in Fujian were consolidated into fifty-three posts, and those in Jiang-Zhe into two hundred twenty-seven posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered each province to consolidate garrison troops: those stationed in Fujian were consolidated into 53 posts, and those in Jiang-Zhe into 227 posts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封諸王鐵木而不花為鎮西武靖王，賜駝紐印。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Prince Tiemur Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince Pacifier of the West, Martial and Tranquil, and granted a camel-button seal.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Tiemur Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince Pacifier of the West, Martial and Tranquil, and granted a camel-button seal.

sentences.zh: 以江西省左丞八都馬辛為中書左丞。

translations.literal: Badmashin, left vice chancellor of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Badmashin, left vice chancellor of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，劄魯忽赤脫而速受賂，為其奴所告，毒殺其奴，坐棄市。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Jalughuchi Tersu accepted bribes; when his slave reported him, he poisoned the slave to death and was sentenced to execution in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jalughuchi Tersu accepted bribes; when his slave reported him, he poisoned the slave to death and was sentenced to execution in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣阿裏以鈔八萬錠糴糧和林。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Ali was dispatched with eighty thousand ingots of paper currency to purchase grain at Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Ali was dispatched with 80,000 ingots of paper currency to purchase grain at Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禁正月至七月捕獵，大都八百里內亦如之。

translations.literal: On dinghai day hunting was forbidden from the first through seventh months, likewise within eight hundred li of Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day hunting was forbidden from the first through seventh months, likewise within 800 li of Dadu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立江淮等處財賦總管府及提舉司。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the Jiang-Huai and other regions revenue supervisorate and intendant commissions were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Jiang-Huai and other regions revenue supervisorate and intendant commissions were established.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王嶽木忽而及兀魯思不花金各百兩，兀魯思不花母阿不察等金五百兩，銀鈔有差。

translations.literal: Princes Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa were each granted one hundred taels of gold; Ulus Buqa's mother Abucha and others five hundred taels of gold; silver and paper currency in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa were each granted 100 taels of gold; Ulus Buqa's mother Abucha and others 500 taels of gold; silver and paper currency in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 賜稱海匠戶市農具鈔二萬二千九百餘錠，及牙忽都所部貧戶萬錠，別吉韂匠萬九百餘錠。

translations.literal: Granted to Changhai artisan households twenty-two thousand nine hundred-odd ingots of paper currency to purchase farm implements, ten thousand ingots to impoverished households under Yaqutu, and ten thousand nine hundred-odd ingots to beji saddle artisans.
translations.idiomatic: Granted to Changhai artisan households 22,900-odd ingots of paper currency to purchase farm implements, 10,000 ingots to impoverished households under Yaqutu, and 10,900-odd ingots to beji saddle artisans.

sentences.zh: 五臺山佛寺成，皇太后將親往祈祝，監察御史李元禮上封事止之。

translations.literal: When the Wutai Mountain Buddhist temple was completed, the empress dowager was about to go in person to pray and offer blessings; surveillance commissioner Li Yuanli submitted a sealed memorial to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wutai Mountain Buddhist temple was completed, the empress dowager was about to go in person to pray and offer blessings; surveillance commissioner Li Yuanli submitted a sealed memorial to stop it.

sentences.zh: 歸德、徐、邳、汴梁諸縣水，免其田租。

translations.literal: Guide, Xu, Pi, and Bianliang counties suffered flooding; their field rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Guide, Xu, Pi, and Bianliang counties suffered flooding; their field rents were remitted.

sentences.zh: 道州旱，遼陽饑，並發粟賑之。

translations.literal: Daozhou suffered drought and Liaoyang famine; grain was issued to relieve both.
translations.idiomatic: Daozhou suffered drought and Liaoyang famine; grain was issued to relieve both.

sentences.zh: 嶽木忽而及兀魯思不花所部民饑，以乳牛牡馬濟之。

translations.literal: The people under Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa suffered famine; dairy cows and stallions were provided to aid them.
translations.idiomatic: The people under Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa suffered famine; dairy cows and stallions were provided to aid them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guisi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guisi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙申，中書省、御史臺臣言：「阿老瓦丁及崔彧條陳臺憲諸事，臣等議，乞依舊例。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Central Secretariat and Censorate officials said: "Alawadin and Cui Yu have itemized matters concerning the censorate and surveillance agencies; we deliberated and request that the old precedents be followed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day central secretariat and censorate officials said, "Alawadin and Cui Yu have itemized matters concerning the censorate and surveillance agencies; we deliberated and request that the old precedents be followed.

sentences.zh: 御史臺不立選，其用人則於常調官選之，惟監察御史首領官，令御史臺自選。

translations.literal: The Censorate shall not establish a separate selection list; its personnel shall be chosen from regularly transferred officials, save that surveillance commissioners as chief officers shall be selected by the Censorate itself.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate shall not establish a separate selection list; its personnel shall be chosen from regularly transferred officials, save that surveillance commissioners as chief officers shall be selected by the censorate itself.

sentences.zh: 各道廉訪司必擇蒙古人為使，或闕，則以色目世臣子孫為之，其次參以色目、漢人。

translations.literal: Each circuit surveillance commission must select a Mongol as commissioner; if none is available, then a semuren hereditary-official descendant; below that, semuren and Han may be mixed in.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit surveillance commission must select a Mongol as commissioner; if none is available, then a semuren hereditary-official descendant; below that, semuren and Han may be mixed in.

sentences.zh: 又合剌赤、阿速各舉監察御史非便，亦宜止於常選擇人。

translations.literal: Further, for Kheshig and Asud each to nominate surveillance commissioners is inconvenient; they too should be limited to selection from regular transfers.
translations.idiomatic: Further, for Kheshig and Asud each to nominate surveillance commissioners is inconvenient; they too should be limited to selection from regular transfers.

sentences.zh: 各省文案，行臺差官檢核。

translations.literal: Documents of each province shall be audited by officials dispatched from the branch censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Documents of each province shall be audited by officials dispatched from the branch censorate.

sentences.zh: 宿衛近侍，奉特旨令臺憲擢用者，必須明奏，然後任之。

translations.literal: For palace guards and personal attendants whom special edict directs the censorate and surveillance agencies to promote, explicit memorial must first be submitted before appointment.
translations.idiomatic: For palace guards and personal attendants whom special edict directs the censorate and surveillance agencies to promote, explicit memorial must first be submitted before appointment.

sentences.zh: 行臺御史秩滿而有效績者，或遷內臺，或呈中書省遷調，廉訪司亦如之；

translations.literal: Branch censorate commissioners who complete their terms with effective performance may be transferred to the inner censorate or recommended to the Central Secretariat for reassignment; surveillance commissions likewise;
translations.idiomatic: Branch censorate commissioners who complete their terms with effective performance may be transferred to the inner censorate or recommended to the central secretariat for reassignment; surveillance commissions likewise;

sentences.zh: 其不稱職者，省、臺擇人代之。

translations.literal: those unfit for office shall be replaced by persons chosen by the secretariat or censorate.
translations.idiomatic: those unfit for office shall be replaced by persons chosen by the secretariat or censorate.

sentences.zh: 未歷有司者，授以牧民之職；

translations.literal: those who have not served in executive offices shall be given posts governing the people;
translations.idiomatic: those who have not served in executive offices shall be given posts governing the people;

sentences.zh: 經省、臺同選者，聽御史臺自調。

translations.literal: those jointly selected by secretariat and censorate may be assigned at the Censorate's discretion.
translations.idiomatic: those jointly selected by secretariat and censorate may be assigned at the censorate's discretion.

sentences.zh: 中書省或用臺察之人，亦宜與御史臺同議，各官府憲司官，毋得輒入體察。

translations.literal: When the Central Secretariat wishes to use censorial personnel, it should likewise deliberate with the Censorate; officials of each agency and surveillance commission must not enter and inspect on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: When the central secretariat wishes to use censorial personnel, it should likewise deliberate with the censorate; officials of each agency and surveillance commission must not enter and inspect on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 今擬除轉運鹽使司外，其餘官府悉依舊例。

translations.literal: We now propose that except for transport-salt commissions, all other agencies follow entirely the old precedents.
translations.idiomatic: We now propose that except for transport-salt commissions, all other agencies follow entirely the old precedents.

sentences.zh: 」制曰：「可。

translations.literal: " The decision said: "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: The decision said, "Approved."

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，賜兀魯思不花圓符。

translations.literal: On renyin day Ulus Buqa was granted a round tally.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Ulus Buqa was granted a round tally.

sentences.zh: 賜暹國、羅斛來朝者衣服有差。

translations.literal: Those from Siam and Lavo who came to court were granted clothing in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Those from Siam and Lavo who came to court were granted clothing in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 賜牙忽都部鈔萬錠，給嶽木忽而所部和林屯田種，以米二千石賑應昌府。

translations.literal: Ten thousand ingots were granted to Yaqutu's household; seed for garrison farming at Karakorum was given to Yuemuhuer's household; two thousand shi of grain relieved Yingchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots were granted to Yaqutu's household; seed for garrison farming at Karakorum was given to Yuemuhuer's household; 2,000 shi of grain relieved Yingchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，河決汴梁，發民三萬餘人塞之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingyin day: the Yellow River breached its banks at Bianliang; more than thirty thousand civilians were mobilized to block it.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingyin day: the Yellow River breached its banks at Bianliang; more than 30,000 civilians were mobilized to block it.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，安南國遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Annam sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Annam sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 追收諸位下為商者制書、驛券。

translations.literal: Commissioners' patents and relay tickets issued to princes conducting commerce were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners' patents and relay tickets issued to princes conducting commerce were recalled.

sentences.zh: 命回回人在內郡輸商稅。

translations.literal: An order directed Muslim merchants in inner commanderies to pay commercial taxes.
translations.idiomatic: An order directed Muslim merchants in inner commanderies to pay commercial taxes.

sentences.zh: 給鈔千錠建臨洮佛寺。

translations.literal: One thousand ingots were granted to build a Buddhist temple at Lintao.
translations.idiomatic: 1,000 ingots were granted to build a Buddhist temple at Lintao.

sentences.zh: 詔強盜奸傷事主者，首從悉誅；

translations.literal: An edict: for robbers who raped and injured victims, leaders and followers all executed;
translations.idiomatic: An edict: for robbers who raped and injured victims, leaders and followers all executed;

sentences.zh: 不傷事主，止誅為首者，從者剌配，再犯亦誅。

translations.literal: where victims were not injured, only the leader executed, followers tattooed and exiled, and repeat offenders likewise executed.
translations.idiomatic: where victims were not injured, only the leader executed, followers tattooed and exiled, and repeat offenders likewise executed.

sentences.zh: 給葛蠻安撫司驛券一。

translations.literal: One relay ticket was granted to the Gemman pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: One relay ticket was granted to the Gemman pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遂寧州軍戶任福妻一產三男，給復三歲。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the wife of military-household man Ren Fu of Suining Prefecture bore three sons in one delivery; corvée was remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the wife of military-household man Ren Fu of Suining Prefecture bore three sons in one delivery; corvée was remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太白犯鬼積屍氣。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Venus transgressed Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Venus transgressed Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: On yihai day the Moon transgressed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Moon transgressed Fang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，禁民間捕鬻鷹鷂。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the people were forbidden to catch and sell hawks and falcons.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the people were forbidden to catch and sell hawks and falcons.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，平伐酋領內附，乞隸於亦乞不薛，從之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day a Pingfa chieftain submitted and requested subordination to Yiqibuxie; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day a Pingfa chieftain submitted and requested subordination to Yiqibuxie; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 各路平準行用庫，舊制選部民富有力者為副，命自今以常調官為之，隸行省者從行省署用。

translations.literal: For route-level leveling circulation offices, the old system selected wealthy and capable local residents as deputies; an order directed that henceforth regularly transferred officials be appointed; those subordinate to branch secretariats were to be assigned by the branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: For route-level leveling circulation offices, the old system selected wealthy and capable local residents as deputies; an order directed that henceforth regularly transferred officials be appointed; those subordinate to branch secretariats were to be assigned by the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 上思州叛賊黃勝許遣其子誌寶來降。

translations.literal: Huang Shengxu, rebel bandit of Shangsi Prefecture, sent his son Zhibao to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shengxu, rebel bandit of Shangsi Prefecture, sent his son Zhibao to submit.

sentences.zh: 漳河溢，損民禾稼。

translations.literal: The Zhang River overflowed and damaged the people's grain crops.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhang River overflowed and damaged the people's grain crops.

sentences.zh: 饒州鄱陽、樂平及隆興路水。

translations.literal: Poyang and Leping in Raozhou and Longxing Route suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Poyang and Leping in Raozhou and Longxing Route suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 亦乞列等二站饑，賑米一百五十石。

translations.literal: Yiqilie and two other stations suffered famine; one hundred fifty shi of grain was issued as relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yiqilie and two other stations suffered famine; 150 shi of grain was issued as relief.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，諸王也裏幹遣使乘驛祀五嶽、四瀆，命追其驛券，仍切責之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiawu day: Prince Yeligan sent envoys using relay posts to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers; an order recalled their relay tickets and sternly rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiawu day: Prince Yeligan sent envoys using relay posts to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers; an order recalled their relay tickets and sternly rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 以湖廣行省參政崔良知廉貧，特賜鹽課鈔千錠。

translations.literal: Because Huguang branch secretariat associate administrator Cui Zhiliang was honest but impoverished, one thousand ingots of salt-levy paper currency were specially granted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Huguang branch secretariat associate administrator Cui Zhiliang was honest but impoverished, 1,000 ingots of salt-levy paper currency were specially granted.

sentences.zh: 給和林軍需鈔十萬錠。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand ingots were granted for Karakorum military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: 100,000 ingots were granted for Karakorum military supplies.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Venus was visible in daytime.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，平伐九寨來降，立長官司。

translations.literal: On wuxu day nine stockades of Pingfa submitted; a native-official office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day nine stockades of Pingfa submitted; a native-official office was established.

sentences.zh: 己酉，令各部宿衛士輸上都、隆興糧各萬五千石於北地。

translations.literal: On jiyou day each palace-guard unit was ordered to deliver fifteen thousand shi of grain each to Shangdu and Longxing in the northern territories.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day each palace-guard unit was ordered to deliver 15,000 shi of grain each to Shangdu and Longxing in the northern territories.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷亦奚不薛歲貢馬及氈衣。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the annual tribute of horses and felt garments from Yixibuxue was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the annual tribute of horses and felt garments from Yixibuxue was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，監察御史斡羅失剌言：「中丞崔彧兄在先朝嘗有罪，還其所籍家產非宜。

translations.literal: On bingchen day surveillance commissioner Woluoshila said: "Vice censor-in-chief Cui Yu's elder brother once committed an offense under the former court; restoring his confiscated household property is improper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day surveillance commissioner Woluoshila said, "Vice censor-in-chief Cui Yu's elder brother once committed an offense under the former court; restoring his confiscated household property is improper.

sentences.zh: 又買僧寺水碾違制。

translations.literal: He also purchased a monastic water mill in violation of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: He also purchased a monastic water mill in violation of regulations.

sentences.zh: 」帝以其妄言，笞之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor considered his statement reckless and had him beaten with the bastinado.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor considered his statement reckless and had him beaten with the bastinado.

sentences.zh: 詔僧道犯奸盜重罪者，聽有司鞫問。

translations.literal: An edict: monks and Daoists who commit rape, theft, or other serious crimes may be interrogated by the regular authorities.
translations.idiomatic: An edict: monks and Daoists who commit rape, theft, or other serious crimes may be interrogated by the regular authorities.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王也裏幹等從者鈔二萬錠，朵思麻一十三站貧民五千餘錠。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand ingots were granted to the followers of Prince Yeligan and others; five thousand-odd ingots to impoverished people at thirteen stations of Duosima.
translations.idiomatic: 20,000 ingots were granted to the followers of Prince Yeligan and others; 5,000-odd ingots to impoverished people at 13 stations of Duosima.

sentences.zh: 是月，平灤路蟲食桑，歸德徐、邳州蝗，太原風、雹，河間、大名路旱，和州歷陽縣江漲，漂沒廬舍萬八千五百餘家。

translations.literal: That month: Pinghuan Route suffered silkworms eating mulberry leaves; Guide, Xu, and Pi Prefectures locusts; Taiyuan wind and hail; Hejian and Daming Route drought; Liyang County in He Prefecture Yangtze flooding, drowning more than eighteen thousand five hundred dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: That month: Pinghuan Route suffered silkworms eating mulberry leaves; Guide, Xu, and Pi Prefectures locusts; Taiyuan wind and hail; Hejian and Daming Route drought; Liyang County in He Prefecture Yangtze flooding, drowning more than 18,500 dwellings.

sentences.zh: 以糧四千餘石賑廣平路饑民，萬五千石賑江西被水之家，二百九十餘石賑鐵裏幹等四站饑戶。

translations.literal: More than four thousand shi of grain relieved famine victims in Guangping Route; fifteen thousand shi relieved flood-stricken households in Jiangxi; more than two hundred ninety shi relieved famine households at four stations including Tieligan.
translations.idiomatic: More than 4,000 shi of grain relieved famine victims in Guangping Route; 15,000 shi relieved flood-stricken households in Jiangxi; more than 290 shi relieved famine households at four stations including Tieligan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，太陰犯房。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu day: the Moon transgressed Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu day: the Moon transgressed Fang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜諸王脫脫、孛羅赤、沙禿而鈔二千錠，所部八萬四千餘錠，撒都失裏千錠，所部二萬餘錠。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Toto, Boluochi, and Shatuo'er were each granted two thousand ingots, their households more than eighty-four thousand ingots; Sadushili one thousand ingots, his households more than twenty thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Toto, Boluochi, and Shatuo'er were each granted 2,000 ingots, their households more than 84,000 ingots; Sadushili 1,000 ingots, his households more than 20,000 ingots.

sentences.zh: 罷蒙古軍萬戶府入曲先塔林都元帥府。

translations.literal: The Mongol Army wanhu office was abolished and merged into the Quxiantalin Chief Commander's Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol Army wanhu office was abolished and merged into the Quxiantalin Chief Commander's Office.

sentences.zh: 癸未，增晉王所部屯田戶。

translations.literal: On guiwei day garrison-farming households under the Prince of Jin were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day garrison-farming households under the Prince of Jin were increased.

sentences.zh: 甲申，增中禦府官一員。

translations.literal: On jiashen day one post was added to the Central Imperial Guard Office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day one post was added to the Central Imperial Guard Office.

sentences.zh: 賜馬八兒國塔喜二珠虎符。

translations.literal: A two-pearl tiger tally was granted to Tazi of Ma'bar.
translations.idiomatic: A two-pearl tiger tally was granted to Tazi of Ma'bar.

sentences.zh: 詔出使招諭者授以招諭使、副；

translations.literal: An edict: those dispatched on missions to summon and instruct were granted the titles envoy to summon and instruct and deputy;
translations.idiomatic: An edict: those dispatched on missions to summon and instruct were granted the titles envoy to summon and instruct and deputy;

sentences.zh: 諸取藥物者，授以會同館使、副，但降旨差遣，不給制命。

translations.literal: those fetching medicinals were granted Huitong Hostel commissioner and deputy; only edict-dispatch was issued, without formal commission.
translations.idiomatic: those fetching medicinals were granted Huitong Hostel commissioner and deputy; only edict-dispatch was issued, without formal commission.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以八兒思禿倉糧隸上都留守司，招籍宋兩江鎮守軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu day grain at Ba'ersi Tucang was placed under the Shangdu defense commissioner; Song troops garrisoning the Two Jiang were registered and recruited.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day grain at Ba'ersi Tucang was placed under the Shangdu defense commissioner; Song troops garrisoning the Two Jiang were registered and recruited.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免上都酒課三年。

translations.literal: On dinghai day wine levies at Shangdu were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day wine levies at Shangdu were remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王不顏鐵木而及其弟伯真孛羅鈔四千錠，所部八萬四千八百餘錠，仍給糧一年。

translations.literal: Prince Buyan Temür and his younger brother Bozhen Boluo were granted four thousand ingots, their households more than eighty-four thousand eight hundred ingots, and grain for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Buyan Temür and his younger brother Bozhen Boluo were granted 4,000 ingots, their households more than 84,800 ingots, and grain for one year.

sentences.zh: 寧海州饑，以米九千四百餘石賑之。

translations.literal: Ninghai Prefecture suffered famine; more than nine thousand four hundred shi of grain was issued as relief.
translations.idiomatic: Ninghai Prefecture suffered famine; more than 9,400 shi of grain was issued as relief.

sentences.zh: 河決杞縣蒲口。

translations.literal: The Yellow River breached its banks at Pu mouth in Qi County.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached its banks at Pu mouth in Qi County.

sentences.zh: 郴州路、耒陽州、衡州之酃縣大水山崩，溺死三百餘人。

translations.literal: Chenzhou Route, Leiyang Prefecture, and Ling County in Heng Prefecture suffered great flood and mountain collapse; more than three hundred persons drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou Route, Leiyang Prefecture, and Ling County in Heng Prefecture suffered great flood and mountain collapse; more than 300 persons drowned.

sentences.zh: 懷州武陟縣旱。

translations.literal: Huai Prefecture's Wuzhi County suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Huai Prefecture's Wuzhi County suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，詔合伯留軍五千屯守，令孛來統其餘眾以歸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengzi day, an edict ordered Hebo to leave five thousand troops to garrison; Bolai was ordered to lead the remainder back.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on gengzi day, an edict ordered Hebo to leave 5,000 troops to garrison; Bolai was ordered to lead the remainder back.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命諸王阿只吉自今出獵，悉自供具，毋傷民力。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Prince Azhiji was ordered that from now on when going hunting he must supply everything himself and not harm the people's strength.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Prince Azhiji was ordered that from now on when going hunting he must supply everything himself and not harm the people's strength.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，妖星出奎。

translations.literal: On dingsi day a baleful star appeared at Kui.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day a baleful star appeared at Kui.

sentences.zh: 揚州、淮安、寧海州旱，真定、順德、河間旱、疫，池州、南康、寧國、太平水。

translations.literal: Yangzhou, Huai'an, and Ninghai Prefecture suffered drought; Zhending, Shunde, and Hejian suffered drought and epidemic; Chizhou, Jiankang, Ningguo, and Taiping suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou, Huai'an, and Ninghai Prefecture suffered drought; Zhending, Shunde, and Hejian suffered drought and epidemic; Chizhou, Jiankang, Ningguo, and Taiping suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉朔，妖星復犯奎。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the xinyou new moon, the baleful star again transgressed Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, on the xinyou new moon, the baleful star again transgressed Kui.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，八番、順元等處初隸湖廣，後改隸雲南，雲南戍兵不至，其屯駐舊軍逃亡者眾，仍命湖廣行省遣軍代之。

translations.literal: On renxu day Bazhao, Shunyuan, and other places had initially been subordinated to Huguang, then changed to Yunnan; Yunnan garrison troops did not arrive, and many of the old troops stationed there fled; Huguang branch secretariat was again ordered to dispatch troops to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Bazhao, Shunyuan, and other places had initially been subordinated to Huguang, then changed to Yunnan; Yunnan garrison troops did not arrive, and many of the old troops stationed there fled; Huguang branch secretariat was again ordered to dispatch troops to replace them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，八百媳婦叛，寇徹裏，遣也先不花將兵討之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Eight Hundred Wives rebelled and raided Cheli; Yeshibu was dispatched to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Eight Hundred Wives rebelled and raided Cheli; Yeshibu was dispatched to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔恤諸郡水旱疾疫之家，罷括兩淮民田。

translations.literal: On bingyin day an edict ordered relief for households in every prefecture suffering flood, drought, or epidemic, and abolished the registration survey of civilian fields in the Two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict ordered relief for households in every prefecture suffering flood, drought, or epidemic, and abolished the registration survey of civilian fields in the Two Huai.

sentences.zh: 汰諸王來大都者及宿衛士冗員。

translations.literal: Supernumerary personnel among princes coming to Dadu and palace guards were eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Supernumerary personnel among princes coming to Dadu and palace guards were eliminated.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命平章伯顏專領給賜孤老衣糧。

translations.literal: On dingmao day pingzhang Boyan was ordered to take exclusive charge of distributing clothing and grain to the solitary elderly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day pingzhang Boyan was ordered to take exclusive charge of distributing clothing and grain to the solitary elderly.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕還大都。

translations.literal: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，增海漕為六十五萬石。

translations.literal: On jichou day sea-transport grain was increased to six hundred fifty thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day sea-transport grain was increased to 650,000 shi.

sentences.zh: 罷南丹州安撫司，立慶遠南丹溪洞等處軍民安撫司。

translations.literal: The Nandan Prefecture pacification commission was abolished and the Qingyuan Nandan Xidong and other places military-civilian pacification commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Nandan Prefecture pacification commission was abolished and the Qingyuan Nandan Xidong and other places military-civilian pacification commission was established.

sentences.zh: 詔邊遠官已嘗優升品級而托他事不起者，奪其所升官。

translations.literal: An edict directed that frontier officials who had been preferentially promoted in rank but pleaded other affairs not to take up office should have their promotions stripped.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that frontier officials who had been preferentially promoted in rank but pleaded other affairs not to take up office should have their promotions stripped.

sentences.zh: 平珠、六洞蠻及十部洞蠻皆來降，命以蠻夷官授之。

translations.literal: The Pingzhu, Liudong, and Ten-Department Cave barbarians all came to surrender; they were ordered granted barbarian official posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Pingzhu, Liudong, and Ten-Department Cave barbarians all came to surrender; they were ordered granted barbarian official posts.

sentences.zh: 給衛士牧馬外郡者糧，令毋仰食於民。

translations.literal: Grain was granted to palace guards pasturing horses in outer prefectures, with orders not to rely on the people for food.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was granted to palace guards pasturing horses in outer prefectures, with orders not to rely on the people for food.

sentences.zh: 以劄魯忽赤所追贓物輸中書省。

translations.literal: Goods recovered as stolen property by Jalarghuchi were delivered to the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Goods recovered as stolen property by Jalarghuchi were delivered to the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 衛輝路旱、疫，澧州、常德、饒州、臨江等路，溫之平陽、瑞安二州大水，鎮江之丹陽、金壇旱，並以糧給之。

translations.literal: Weihui Route suffered drought and epidemic; Lizhou, Changde, Raozhou, Linjiang, and other routes, Pingyang and Ruian prefectures of Wenzhou, suffered severe flooding; Danyang and Jintan in Zhenjiang suffered drought — grain was issued to relieve them all.
translations.idiomatic: Weihui Route suffered drought and epidemic; Lizhou, Changde, Raozhou, Linjiang, and other routes, Pingyang and Ruian prefectures of Wenzhou, suffered severe flooding; Danyang and Jintan in Zhenjiang suffered drought — grain was issued to relieve them all.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，詔諸遷轉官註闕二年。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu day an edict ordered that all transferred officials fill vacancies for two years.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu day an edict ordered that all transferred officials fill vacancies for two years.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，有事於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day there were ceremonies at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day there were ceremonies at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，減上都商稅歲額為三千錠。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Shangdu's annual commercial tax quota was reduced to three thousand ingots.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Shangdu's annual commercial tax quota was reduced to 3,000 ingots.

sentences.zh: 溫州陳空崖等以妖言伏誅。

translations.literal: Chen Kongya and others of Wenzhou were executed for seditionist speech.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kongya and others of Wenzhou were executed for seditionist speech.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免陜西鹽戶差稅，罷其所給米。

translations.literal: On guichou day Shaanxi salt-household corvée taxes were remitted and the rice they had been granted was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Shaanxi salt-household corvée taxes were remitted and the rice they had been granted was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，爪哇遣失剌班直木達奉表來降。

translations.literal: On yimao day Java sent Shilaban Zhimuda bearing a memorial to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Java sent Shilaban Zhimuda bearing a memorial to submit.

sentences.zh: 戊午，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 增吏部尚書一員。

translations.literal: One Minister of Personnel was added.
translations.idiomatic: One Minister of Personnel was added.

sentences.zh: 以朵甘思十九站貧乏，賜馬牛羊有差。

translations.literal: Because nineteen relay stations of Do Kham were impoverished, horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Because 19 relay stations of Do Kham were impoverished, horses, cattle, and sheep were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 廬州路無為州江潮泛溢，漂沒廬舍。

translations.literal: In Wuwei Prefecture of Luzhou Route the river tide overflowed, washing away dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In Wuwei Prefecture of Luzhou Route the river tide overflowed, washing away dwellings.

sentences.zh: 歷陽、合肥、梁縣及安豐之蒙城、霍丘自春及秋不雨，揚州、淮安路饑，韶州、南雄、建德、溫州皆大水，並賑之。

translations.literal: Liyang, Hefei, Liang County, and Mengcheng and Huoqiu in Anfeng had no rain from spring through autumn; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered famine; Shaozhou, Nanxiong, Jiande, and Wenzhou all suffered severe flooding — all were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Liyang, Hefei, Liang County, and Mengcheng and Huoqiu in Anfeng had no rain from spring through autumn; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered famine; Shaozhou, Nanxiong, Jiande, and Wenzhou all suffered severe flooding — all were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，禁權豪、僧、道及各位下擅據礦炭山場。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu day powerful families, monks, Taoists, and persons of every appanage were forbidden to seize coal and mining hill sites without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on renxu day powerful families, monks, Taoists, and persons of every appanage were forbidden to seize coal and mining hill sites without authorization.

sentences.zh: 罷順德、彰德、廣平等路五提舉司，立都提舉司二，升正四品，設官四員，直隸中書戶部。

translations.literal: Five supervisory offices of Shunde, Zhangde, Guangping, and other routes were abolished; two metropolitan supervisory offices were established, promoted to rank 4a, with four officials each, directly subordinate to the central secretariat Households Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Five supervisory offices of Shunde, Zhangde, Guangping, and other routes were abolished; two metropolitan supervisory offices were established, promoted to rank 4a, with four officials each, directly subordinate to the central secretariat Households Ministry.

sentences.zh: 衛輝路提舉司隸廣平彰德都提舉司，真定鐵冶隸順德都提舉司。

translations.literal: Weihui Route supervisory office was subordinated to the Guangping-Zhangde metropolitan supervisory office; Zhending ironworks were subordinated to the Shunde metropolitan supervisory office.
translations.idiomatic: Weihui Route supervisory office was subordinated to the Guangping-Zhangde metropolitan supervisory office; Zhending ironworks were subordinated to the Shunde metropolitan supervisory office.

sentences.zh: 罷保定紫荊關鐵治提舉司，還其戶八百為民。

translations.literal: The Baoding Zijing Pass ironworks supervisory office was abolished and its eight hundred households were returned to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: The Baoding Zijing Pass ironworks supervisory office was abolished and its 800 households were returned to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔自今田獵始自九月。

translations.literal: On guihai day an edict ordered that from now on field hunting begin in the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered that from now on field hunting begin in the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 高麗王王巨告老，乞以爵與其子謜。

translations.literal: King Wang Ju of Goryeo requested retirement, asking that his title be given to his son Chon.
translations.idiomatic: King Wang Ju of Goryeo requested retirement, asking that his title be given to his son Chon.

sentences.zh: 福建行省遣人覘琉求國，俘其傍近百人以歸。

translations.literal: Fujian branch secretariat dispatched men to reconnoiter Ryukyu and captured nearly one hundred persons nearby and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian branch secretariat dispatched men to reconnoiter Ryukyu and captured nearly 100 persons nearby and returned.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，增太廟牲用馬。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the horses used for sacrificial victims at the Imperial Ancestral Temple were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the horses used for sacrificial victims at the Imperial Ancestral Temple were increased.

sentences.zh: 庚午，籍唐兀軍入樞密院。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Tangut troops were registered and entered the privy council.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Tangut troops were registered and entered the privy council.

sentences.zh: 辛未，曹州禹城進嘉禾，一莖九穗。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Yucheng in Caozhou presented an auspicious grain stalk with nine ears on one stem.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Yucheng in Caozhou presented an auspicious grain stalk with nine ears on one stem.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔以高麗王世子謜為開府儀同三司、征東行中書省左丞相、駙馬、上柱國、高麗國王，仍加授王巨為推忠宣力定遠保節功臣、開府儀同三司、太尉、駙馬、上柱國、逸壽王。

translations.literal: On dingchou day an edict made Goryeo crown prince Chon Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat, imperial son-in-law, pillar of state, and king of Goryeo; Wang Ju was further enfeoffed as Prince of Yishou with the merit title Loyalty-proclaiming, Power-assisting, Far-stabilizing, Integrity-preserving Merit Lord, Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, Grand Marshal, imperial son-in-law, and pillar of state.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict made Goryeo crown prince Chon Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, left grand councillor of the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat, imperial son-in-law, pillar of state, and king of Goryeo; Wang Ju was further enfeoffed as Prince of Yishou with the merit title Loyalty-proclaiming, Power-assisting, Far-stabilizing, Integrity-preserving Merit Lord, Minister of State with the Palace of the First Rank, Grand Marshal, imperial son-in-law, and pillar of state.

sentences.zh: 增烏撒烏蒙等處宣慰使一員，以孛羅歡為之。

translations.literal: One pacification commissioner for Wusa, Wumeng, and other places was added; Boluohuan was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: One pacification commissioner for Wusa, Wumeng, and other places was added; Boluohuan was appointed.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王兀魯思不花金千兩、銀萬五千兩、鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: Prince Ulusi Buqa was granted one thousand liang of gold, fifteen thousand liang of silver, and ten thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ulusi Buqa was granted 1,000 liang of gold, 15,000 liang of silver, and 10,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 徙大同路軍儲所於紅城。

translations.literal: The Datong Route military grain depot was moved to Hongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Datong Route military grain depot was moved to Hongcheng.

sentences.zh: 以河南行省經用不足，命江浙行省運米二十萬石給之。

translations.literal: Because Henan branch secretariat's operating expenses were insufficient, Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat was ordered to transport two hundred thousand shi of rice to supply it.
translations.idiomatic: Because Henan branch secretariat's operating expenses were insufficient, Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat was ordered to transport 200,000 shi of rice to supply it.

sentences.zh: 總帥汪惟和以所部軍屯田沙州、瓜州，給中統鈔二萬三千二百餘錠置種、牛、田具。

translations.literal: Commander-in-chief Wang Weihe was ordered to garrison-farm at Shazhou and Guazhou with his troops; more than twenty-three thousand two hundred ingots of Zhongtong notes were granted for seed, cattle, and farm implements.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Wang Weihe was ordered to garrison-farm at Shazhou and Guazhou with his troops; more than 23,200 ingots of Zhongtong notes were granted for seed, cattle, and farm implements.

sentences.zh: 大都路總管沙的坐贓當罷，帝以故臣子，特減其罪，俾仍舊職。

translations.literal: Dadu Route chief administrator Shadi, guilty of corruption and due for dismissal, the Emperor because he was a former subject specially reduced his punishment and allowed him to remain in office.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu Route chief administrator Shadi, guilty of corruption and due for dismissal, the Emperor because he was a former subject specially reduced his punishment and allowed him to remain in office.

sentences.zh: 崔彧言不可復任，帝曰：「卿等與中書省臣戒之，若後復然，則置爾死地矣。

translations.literal: Cui Yu said he should not be reappointed; the Emperor said: "You and the central secretariat officials shall warn him; if afterwards he again does so, you will be put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yu said he should not be reappointed; the Emperor said, "You and the central secretariat officials shall warn him; if afterwards he again does so, you will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，太白經天。

translations.literal: " On wuzi day Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 增晉王內史一員，尚乘寺卿一員。

translations.literal: One Prince of Jin chief secretary and one Director of the Palace Transport Bureau were added.
translations.idiomatic: One Prince of Jin chief secretary and one Director of the Palace Transport Bureau were added.

sentences.zh: 賜藥木忽而金一千二百五十兩、銀一萬五千兩、鈔一萬二千錠。

translations.literal: Yaomuhu'er was granted one thousand two hundred fifty liang of gold, fifteen thousand liang of silver, and twelve thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Yaomuhu'er was granted 1,250 liang of gold, 15,000 liang of silver, and 12,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 常德路大水，常州路及宜興州旱，並賑之。

translations.literal: Changde Route suffered severe flooding; Changzhou Route and Yixing Prefecture suffered drought — all were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Changde Route suffered severe flooding; Changzhou Route and Yixing Prefecture suffered drought — all were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，令也速帶而、藥樂罕將兵出征。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guisi day Yesudai'er and Yaolehuan were ordered to lead troops on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on guisi day Yesudai'er and Yaolehuan were ordered to lead troops on campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙申，徙襄陽屯田合剌魯軍於南陽，戶受田百五十畝，給種、牛、田具。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the Qoraclut garrison-farm troops at Xiangyang were moved to Nanyang; each household received one hundred fifty mu of fields, with seed, cattle, and farm implements supplied.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Qoraclut garrison-farm troops at Xiangyang were moved to Nanyang; each household received 150 mu of fields, with seed, cattle, and farm implements supplied.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，中書省臣同河南平章孛羅歡等言：「世祖撫定江南，沿江上下置戍兵三十一翼，今無一二，懼有不虞。

translations.idiomatic: Princes' attendants were forbidden to borrow crane-control credentials and belts to harass the people.

translations.idiomatic: An order forbade officials from accepting bribes and then summoning the briber to report to various offices; such reports were not to be received at will.

translations.literal: Ninth month, jichou day, the Emperor's birthday: the court halted at Zugui and received congratulations from princes and officials of all ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jichou day, the Emperor's birthday: the court halted at Zugui and received congratulations from princes and officials of all ranks.

sentences.zh: 交趾、爪哇、金齒國各貢方物。

translations.literal: Champa, Java, and Jinzhi each presented local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa, Java, and Jinzhi each presented local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 給和林更戍軍牛、車。

translations.literal: Cattle and carts were granted to the rotational garrison troops at Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: Cattle and carts were granted to the rotational garrison troops at Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 丙申，車駕還大都。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太陰犯五車南星。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the moon transgressed the southern star of the Five Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the moon transgressed the southern star of the Five Chariots.

sentences.zh: 命廣海、左右江戍軍依舊制以二年或三年更代。

translations.literal: Guanghai and the Left and Right Two Rivers garrison troops were ordered to rotate garrison duty every two or three years according to the former regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghai and the Left and Right Two Rivers garrison troops were ordered to rotate garrison duty every two or three years according to the former regulation.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯五諸侯。

translations.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed the Five Feudal Lords.

sentences.zh: 樞密副使塔剌忽帶犯贓罪，命御史臺鞫之。

translations.literal: Privy Council Vice Commissioner Talaghudai was guilty of embezzlement; the censorate was ordered to try him.
translations.idiomatic: Privy council vice commissioner Talaghudai was guilty of embezzlement; the censorate was ordered to try him.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太陰犯左執法。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the moon transgressed the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，吉、贛立屯田；

translations.literal: On gengxu day garrison farming was established at Ji and Gan;
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day garrison farming was established at Ji and Gan;

sentences.zh: 減中外冗員。

translations.literal: redundant staff within and without the court was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: redundant staff within and without the court was reduced.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅朔，增海漕米為七十萬石。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiayin new moon: sea-transport grain was increased to seven hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiayin new moon, sea-transport grain was increased to 700,000 shi.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，太白犯牽牛。

translations.literal: On renxu day Venus transgressed Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Venus transgressed Ox.

sentences.zh: 置蒙古都萬戶府於鳳翔，立平珠、六洞蠻夷長官司二，設土官四十四員。

translations.literal: The Mongol Chief Ten-Thousand-Household Office was established at Fengxiang; two offices of native chiefs for the Pingzhu and Liudong Man barbarians were established, with forty-four local officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The Mongol chief ten-thousand-household office was established at Fengxiang; two offices of native chiefs for the Pingzhu and Liudong Man barbarians were established, with 44 local officials appointed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太陰犯角距星。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the moon transgressed the distance star of Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon transgressed the distance star of Horn.

sentences.zh: 令御史臺檢劾樞密院案牘。

translations.literal: The censorate was ordered to inspect and impeach Privy Council case records.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered to inspect and impeach privy council case records.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王嶽木忽而、兀魯忽不花所部糧五萬石；

translations.literal: Fifty thousand shi of grain were granted to the households under Princes Yuemuhu'er and Ulus Hubuhua;
translations.idiomatic: 50,000 shi of grain were granted to the households under Princes Yuemuhu'er and Ulus Hubuhua;

sentences.zh: 控鶴七百人，賜鈔五百錠。

translations.literal: seven hundred crane controllers were granted five hundred ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: 700 crane controllers were granted 500 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，安南貢方物。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengyin day: Annam presented local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, Annam presented local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙申，知樞密院那懷言：「常例文移，乞令副樞以下署行。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Director of the Privy Council Na Huai said: "For routine documents, we request that deputy privy council directors and below be authorized to sign and dispatch them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day director of the privy council Na Huai said, "For routine documents, we request that deputy privy council directors and below be authorized to sign and dispatch them.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 罷雲南行御史臺，置肅政廉訪司。

translations.literal: The Yunnan branch censorate was abolished and a rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan branch censorate was abolished and a rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commission was established.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On jihai day the moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，辰星犯牽牛。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Mercury transgressed Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Mercury transgressed Ox.

sentences.zh: 罷徐、邳爐冶所進息錢。

translations.literal: The remittance of interest money submitted by the Xu and Pi smelting offices was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The remittance of interest money submitted by the Xu and Pi smelting offices was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 以中書右丞王慶端為平章政事。

translations.literal: Wang Qingduan, right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qingduan, right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 賜和林軍校幣六千匹，衣帽等物有差。

translations.literal: Six thousand bolts of cloth were granted to Karakorum military officers, with clothing, hats, and other goods in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: 6,000 bolts of cloth were granted to Karakorum military officers, with clothing, hats, and other goods in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，太白經天。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuwu day: Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuwu day, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 己未，填星犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Saturn transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Saturn transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，太白犯歲星，太陰犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On yichou day Venus transgressed Jupiter, and the moon transgressed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Venus transgressed Jupiter, and the moon transgressed Mars.

sentences.zh: 括諸路馬，除牝孕攜駒者，齒三歲以上並拘之。

translations.literal: Horses on all routes were registered and requisitioned; except pregnant mares with foals at side, all three years of age and above were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Horses on all routes were registered and requisitioned; except pregnant mares with foals at side, all three years of age and above were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 賜朵而朵海所部鈔八十五萬錠。

translations.literal: Eight hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted to the household under Duo Erduo Hai.
translations.idiomatic: 850,000 ingots of notes were granted to the household under Duo Erduo Hai.

sentences.zh: 庚午，鎮星入輿鬼，太陰犯上將。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Saturn entered Ghost, and the moon transgressed Upper General.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Saturn entered Ghost, and the moon transgressed Upper General.

sentences.zh: 辛未，增置各路推官，專掌刑獄，上路二員，下路一員。

translations.literal: On xinwei day additional reviewing officials were established on each route, exclusively in charge of criminal cases; two on upper routes, one on lower routes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day additional reviewing officials were established on each route, exclusively in charge of criminal cases; two on upper routes, one on lower routes.

sentences.zh: 詔諸逃軍復業者免役三年。

translations.literal: An edict directed that fugitive soldiers who returned to their occupations were exempt from corvée for three years.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that fugitive soldiers who returned to their occupations were exempt from corvée for three years.

sentences.zh: 江浙行省平章政事答剌罕升左丞相。

translations.literal: Darqan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Jiang-Zhe, was promoted to left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Darqan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Jiang-Zhe, was promoted to left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，彗出子孫星下。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day a comet appeared below the Children and Grandchildren Star.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day a comet appeared below the Children and Grandchildren Star.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On jimao day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命廉訪司歲舉所部廉幹者各二人。

translations.literal: On xinsi day rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commissions were ordered each year to recommend two upright and capable men from their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day rectification and anti-corruption surveillance commissions were ordered each year to recommend two upright and capable men from their jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 詔和市價直隨給其主，違者罪之。

translations.literal: An edict directed that government-market purchase pay fair market price promptly to the owners; violators were punished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that government-market purchase pay fair market price promptly to the owners; violators were punished.

sentences.zh: 定諸稅錢三十取一，歲額之上勿增。

translations.literal: Commercial taxes were fixed at one in thirty; the annual quota was not to be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Commercial taxes were fixed at one in thirty; the annual quota was not to be increased.

sentences.zh: 揚州、淮安兩路旱、蝗，以糧十萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered drought and locusts; one hundred thousand shi of grain were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered drought and locusts; 100,000 shi of grain were granted for relief.

sentences.zh: 給陣亡軍妻子衣糧。

translations.literal: Wives and children of soldiers killed in battle were supplied with clothing and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Wives and children of soldiers killed in battle were supplied with clothing and grain.

sentences.zh: 免內郡賦稅。

translations.literal: Taxes of the inner commanderies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes of the inner commanderies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 諸王小薛所部三百餘戶散處鳳翔，以潞州田二千八百頃賜之。

translations.literal: More than three hundred households under Prince Xiao Xue were scattered at Fengxiang; two thousand eight hundred qing of fields in Lu Prefecture were granted to them.
translations.idiomatic: More than 300 households under Prince Xiao Xue were scattered at Fengxiang; 2,800 qing of fields in Lu Prefecture were granted to them.

sentences.zh: 釋在京囚二百一十九人。

translations.literal: Two hundred nineteen prisoners in the capital were released.
translations.idiomatic: 219 prisoners in the capital were released.
